assumptions: Original simplified case reference. Case size, 16 case TAP center locations, thread designation/pitch and maximum depth are drawing facts; local contour simplifications and nominal major-diameter cuts are not manufacturing geometry.

No fitted normal horn, idler horn, bearing or retaining screw is assumed. The source reference sheet illustrates fitted accessories, whose PCDs and diameter 26 are not promoted to bare-case mounting groups.

Main+Z and rear-idler-Z share the documentedX13.75/Y16.75 line. Flush main-interface ring and rear routing cap have explicit planning diameters/contours; no bare-spline outside diameter or tip height has been recovered.

Two bus sockets and their 3 or 4 contacts are recognizable planning parts. Exact socket/header pose, envelope, contact pitch/ordering and access are unknown; guessed millimeters never replace cable-port facts.

Source-only 5 contactExternalPort and 3 contactDualJoint interfaces are recorded separately. Their unresolved internal positions are not rendered as exterior sockets. No attached harness or mating plug is generated.
Rear cable pass-through requires the documented cover/idler assembly procedure. A mechanical route opening is not an extra electrical port or a through-hole across the whole actuator.

Thread DP4.0(Max.) is a maximum stated depth, not a guaranteed usable engagement. The 16 major-diameter cylindrical cuts are visual references; inspect the thread specification before using centers for mounting.

parts.note: AxisX13.75/Y16.75 is source-based. This flush diameter 9 ring is a planning marker for the uninstalled output interface; bare spline diameter and shaft-tip height are not established. The drawing diameter 26 and bolt circle belong to an installed horn, which is omitted.

missing_mount_dimensions: Tap-drill diameter, thread class and actual usable engagement
Bare output-spline contour, uninstalled axial tip/seating datums
Complete socket/plug envelopes and port coordinates
Auxiliary header quantity/pose where not established
Installed horn, idler bearing/frame geometry and clearances

observations.note: Official W270-T/R dimensions 33.5 x 58.5 x 44 corroborate the drawing case. This record is the TTLelectrical variant; protocol pin counts do not identify a physical production revision.
The product package includes a separate normal horn and cables. Included accessories are not assumed fitted. No pigtail cable or horn is installed by this geometry recipe.

Manufacturer-authoredROBOTIS 2019-03-18 drawing, sheet marked 1 of 2, served as a 1-pagePDF by Best Technology. Current official manual links the sameX540 family drawing title through download.php?no=2083, but that endpoint returned 404 during this audit; mirror provenance is explicit. No vendorPDF, image orCADmodel is shipped.

16 case TAP holes are distinct from 4WB M2.5 x 17 assembly fasteners. The 8M2.5 x 0.45 DP2.5(Max.) PCD22 and 4 diameter 2 PCD16 patterns belong to the illustrated installed horn/accessories; none enters this bare-case mount group.

The official W150 page independently gives the same 33.5 x 58.5 x 44 case envelope and links the sameX540 family drawing. This supports a common mechanical reference, not automatic voltage, gear, firmware, accessory or unknown-revision equivalence; no W150 profile is silently aliased.
Idler, bearing and cap are separately assembled at the rear. Their coaxial cable route is mechanical pass-through access, not another electrical port or a permanently installed second output horn.

assumptions: Original simplified case reference. Case size, 16 case TAP center locations, thread designation/pitch and maximum depth are drawing facts; local contour simplifications and nominal major-diameter cuts are not manufacturing geometry.

No fitted normal horn, idler horn, bearing or retaining screw is assumed. The source reference sheet illustrates fitted accessories, whose PCDs and diameter 26 are not promoted to bare-case mounting groups.

Main+Z and rear-idler-Z share the documentedX13.75/Y16.75 line. Flush main-interface ring and rear routing cap have explicit planning diameters/contours; no bare-spline outside diameter or tip height has been recovered.

Two bus sockets and their 3 or 4 contacts are recognizable planning parts. Exact socket/header pose, envelope, contact pitch/ordering and access are unknown; guessed millimeters never replace cable-port facts.

Source-only 5 contactExternalPort and 3 contactDualJoint interfaces are recorded separately. Their unresolved internal positions are not rendered as exterior sockets. No attached harness or mating plug is generated.
Rear cable pass-through requires the documented cover/idler assembly procedure. A mechanical route opening is not an extra electrical port or a through-hole across the whole actuator.

Thread DP4.0(Max.) is a maximum stated depth, not a guaranteed usable engagement. The 16 major-diameter cylindrical cuts are visual references; inspect the thread specification before using centers for mounting.

observations.note: Official W270-T/R dimensions 33.5 x 58.5 x 44 corroborate the drawing case. This record is the RS-485 electrical variant; protocol pin counts do not identify a physical production revision.
The product package includes a separate normal horn and cables. Included accessories are not assumed fitted. No pigtail cable or horn is installed by this geometry recipe.

Manufacturer-authoredROBOTIS 2019-03-18 drawing, sheet marked 1 of 2, served as a 1-pagePDF by Best Technology. Current official manual links the sameX540 family drawing title through download.php?no=2083, but that endpoint returned 404 during this audit; mirror provenance is explicit. No vendorPDF, image orCADmodel is shipped.

16 case TAP holes are distinct from 4WB M2.5 x 17 assembly fasteners. The 8M2.5 x 0.45 DP2.5(Max.) PCD22 and 4 diameter 2 PCD16 patterns belong to the illustrated installed horn/accessories; none enters this bare-case mount group.

The official W150 page independently gives the same 33.5 x 58.5 x 44 case envelope and links the sameX540 family drawing. This supports a common mechanical reference, not automatic voltage, gear, firmware, accessory or unknown-revision equivalence; no W150 profile is silently aliased.
Idler, bearing and cap are separately assembled at the rear. Their coaxial cable route is mechanical pass-through access, not another electrical port or a permanently installed second output horn.
